---
name: manamesh-crypto-package
description: The @manamesh/crypto leaf package — what it owns and how games consume it
metadata:
  type: project
---

`packages/crypto/` (`@manamesh/crypto`) is the shared cryptographic primitives
package, extracted from `manamesh/packages/frontend/src/crypto/` + `src/zk/`. It
is a LEAF package — zero internal deps — so frontend → crypto and poker → crypto
are one-way (no cycles).

- It defines its own minimal `CoreCard` in `plugin/crypto-plugin.ts` (frontend's
  `game/modules/types.ts` keeps its own, structurally compatible — do NOT couple
  crypto back to frontend types).
- Consumers import via explicit subpath exports (`@manamesh/crypto/mental-poker`,
  `/plugin/crypto-plugin`, `/merkle`, `/paillier`, `/zk`, etc.) to keep heavy
  snarkjs/paillier out of light code-split chunks. Barrel `@manamesh/crypto` also works.
